stage_scope.stage_1: Use all CSQA training questions, choices, and question concepts to establish concept coverage and context-aware senses.
stage_scope.stage_2: Generate decontextualized lexical and commonsense facts from selected dictionary senses; do not convert CSQA answer labels into facts.
stage_scope.stage_3: Remove malformed, generic, context-dependent, answer-mapping, and duplicate records; keep runtime fields minimal.

important_limitations: This is a deterministic stage-1-to-3 knowledge base, not a guarantee that every fact will improve an LLM answer.
Whether a fact distinguishes the current five choices must be evaluated by the later runtime validator.
Whether and where to inject a valid fact belongs to the later GRPO routing stage.
